values.note: 'A reservation is required to stay at Balsam Mountain Campground ... there are no provisions to make a reservation once you are at the campground' (little cell coverage). Reservations up to six months ahead. Park stay limit 14 consecutive days.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/273848 (notice 'A reservation is required to stay at Balsam Mountain Campground ... no provisions to make a reservation once you are at the campground'; 'The park stay limit is 14 consecutive days') + https://www.nps.gov/grsm/planyourvisit/balsam-mountain.htm (NPS campground record behind the page, developer.nps.gov/api/v1/campgrounds?parkCode=grsm) ('Campsite reservations are required and may be made up to six months in advance'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: NPS lists the campground closed from 2026-10-12 to 2027-05-15; opening dates vary by year (recreation.gov rate seasons began May 15 in 2026, May 10 in 2024).

season.source: https://www.nps.gov/grsm/planyourvisit/balsam-mountain.htm (NPS campground record behind the page, developer.nps.gov/api/v1/campgrounds?parkCode=grsm) (operatingHours: 'Balsam Mountain Campground closes seasonally'; exception 'Closed' 2026-10-12 to 2027-05-15), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 43 sites, 19 of them tent-only per NPS; recreation.gov lists 14 RV/trailer sites at 24 ft, the rest 12-21 ft; mostly parallel (pull-off) driveways.

sites.source: https://www.nps.gov/grsm/planyourvisit/balsam-mountain.htm (NPS campground record behind the page, developer.nps.gov/api/v1/campgrounds?parkCode=grsm) (totalSites 43, tentOnly 19, rvMaxLength 24, trailerMaxLength 24) + recreation.gov campsite catalog for 273848 (RIDB, fetched 2026-10-20) (Max Vehicle Length 24 at 14 RV/trailer sites, 21 at 3, 20 at 2, 15 at 5, 12 at 2; Driveway Entry Parallel 25, Back-In 1), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/273848 ('There are no hookups or showers at the campground') + https://www.nps.gov/grsm/planyourvisit/balsam-mountain.htm (NPS campground record behind the page, developer.nps.gov/api/v1/campgrounds?parkCode=grsm) (electricalHookups 0), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/273848 ('flush toilets and drinking water. There are no hookups or showers ... No lights are available in the restrooms') + https://www.nps.gov/grsm/planyourvisit/balsam-mountain.htm (NPS campground record behind the page, developer.nps.gov/api/v1/campgrounds?parkCode=grsm) (toilets 'Flush Toilets - seasonal', potableWater 'Yes - seasonal', showers 'None', dumpStation 'No', campStore 'No'), read 2026-10-21

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/273848/rates (2026 and 2027 peak seasons: STANDARD NONELECTRIC $30) + https://www.nps.gov/grsm/planyourvisit/balsam-mountain.htm (NPS campground record behind the page, developer.nps.gov/api/v1/campgrounds?parkCode=grsm) (Camping Fee 30.00 'per site, per night'), read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed $30, reservation-only on recreation.gov (6 months), no hookups/showers, flush toilets and water; added season (closed Oct 12-May 15 per NPS), 43 sites with 14 RV sites at 24 ft, 14-day limit. NPS lists the access roads as paved, all vehicles OK; the only nearby closure is the one-way Balsam Mountain (Heintooga Round Bottom) Road and Straight Fork, beyond the campground.
